title: DigiCert’s 2027 Predictions: AI Gets More Powerful. Businesses Demand More Proof
headline: DigiCert 2027 security predictions for AI agents and enterprise trust
summary: DigiCert’s 2027 security predictions highlight an increasing enterprise demand for verifiable AI agent identities, accountable ownership, and the implementation of kill switches. The report suggests that organisations will shift toward requiring proof of security and content provenance to manage the risks associated with autonomous AI systems and AI-generated code. These measures aim to ensure that AI actions are authorised and that companies can intervene when systems malfunction.
why_it_matters: Australian organisations must prepare for a shift where proof of security, verifiable agent identity, and clear accountability become essential prerequisites for maintaining supplier contracts and enterprise trust.

quotes.text: AI agents will do more work in 2027 and businesses will demand clearer answers about who owns them, what they can do, and how to stop them with a kill switch.
DigiCert, a global leader in intelligent trust, predicts that proof of security will increasingly determine which agents get access, which suppliers win contracts, and which products reach market.

classification.significance_reason: The report outlines emerging industry standards for AI accountability and security that are likely to influence global procurement and compliance expectations.
